micro_topic: Unemployment measures > usual status > chronic unemployment
core_fact: Usual (principal) status, with a 365-day reference period, measures chronic (open, long-term) unemployment; CWS and CDS capture seasonal/underemployment.

statements.label: opt1
statements.text: The method used to calculate chronic unemployment is Usual status unemployment.

statements.label: opt2
statements.text: The method used to calculate chronic unemployment is Current weekly status unemployment.
statements.mechanism: true fact not the one asked

statements.text: The method used to calculate chronic unemployment is Current daily status unemployment.
statements.mechanism: true fact not the one asked

statements.label: opt4
statements.text: The method used to calculate chronic unemployment is All of the above.

reconstruction.correct_statement: Usual status measures chronic unemployment.
reconstruction.micro_topic_rule: US = chronic; CWS = weekly/seasonal; CDS = daily (most comprehensive).

practice: AI-GENERATED PRACTICE (not an APPSC PYQ): 'Current daily status gives the highest unemployment rate of the three' - T.
